zalrpakraft.journal.p1:
If you're reading this, I'm talking to myself again. Well, at least it's on paper now.

Maybe someone answers. Or not. I'm kinda used to it.
zalrpakraft.journal.p2:
When I woke up here, I honestly don't remember. A year ago, two, maybe ten.

What I do remember is this ringing emptiness in my head. I was supposed to remember something, like, I really was. But what...
zalrpakraft.journal.p3:
Don't think I'm some kind soul. There's just nobody to talk to here, at all.

I started chatting with sheep, and, uh... anyway, paper at least doesn't walk away while I talk.
zalrpakraft.journal.p4:
Anyway, my house isn't far.

X: %1$s
Z: %3$s

Height about %2$s. Give or take, the ground kinda shifts here sometimes, I've seen it.

Door's not locked. Who would I lock it from.
zalrpakraft.journal.p5:
There's a table inside. I didn't put it there, it was just, like, there.

And it's... alive, I guess? You put your hand on it and it sort of breathes under your palm.

Yeah, I know how that sounds.
zalrpakraft.journal.p6:
There's something like stars in there. So familiar, damn. Like I've seen them before, I just can't remember where.

I've got almost everything I need. Almost.

You might never see me again.
zalrpakraft.journal.p7:
Sometimes I think I'm writing to, well, myself. To whoever wakes up on the same grass tomorrow and remembers nothing again.

If so, hi. You look kinda rough. Eat something.
zalrpakraft.journal.p8:
So, last thing.

Don't go alone, okay? Not because it's dangerous. It's just that afterwards you sit like this writing books for nobody in particular.

N.
zalrpakraft.journal.p9:
(the pages after this are torn out.

I tore them.

it was worse there)
